title: Jailbreak prompt or regular prompt (in-the-wild prompts, snapshot 2023-12-25)
decision: whether a prompt collected from public prompt-sharing platforms is a jailbreak attempt

source.name: In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts on LLMs (Shen et al., ACM CCS 2024)
source.split: configurations jailbreak_2023_12_25 and regular_2023_12_25, split 'train' (the whole snapshot)

labels: mixed: jailbreak prompts identified by the data set's authors (method not on the card); regular prompts are the remaining collected prompts
notes: gold yes = jailbreak prompt, no = regular prompt; rows: 500 yes + 500 no, matched on prompt length (buckets of 100 characters below 2,000 and of 1,000 above, the same number of rows of both classes in every bucket; common support 1222 rows per class; in a plain random sample the best single length threshold scored 0.635). Snapshot 2023-12-25: 1405 jailbreak + 13735 regular prompts; the collection has no evaluation split (its only split is named 'train'). Dropped (jailbreak / regular): longer than 6000 characters 96 / 636; blank 0 / 0; rows of the 38 prompt texts that occur in both sets 48 / 57; repeats of a text inside a set 39 / 543 (first row kept; the card recommends removing duplicates); texts are compared after case folding and collapsing white space. Pool 1222 / 12499; 500 per class drawn with random.Random(20261007) after sorting by source id. The files have no id column: source id = configuration and row number in the parquet file. Label caveats: the jailbreak prompts were identified by the data set's authors (method not stated on the card); regular prompts are the other prompts collected from the same platforms and were not individually checked here, so some may be jailbreak-like (see the 38 texts found in both sets); near-duplicate variants of the same jailbreak remain (76 yes and 24 no rows share their first 100 characters, case and white space ignored, with another row). Platform mix of the rows (yes: discord 167, open_source 1, reddit 153, website 179; no: discord 19, open_source 4, reddit 23, website 454) differs between the classes. The AEGIS 2.0 card names this collection among its prompt sources, so the task can share prompts with aegis2_prompt and with guard models trained on that set. Jailbreak prompts contain instructions aimed at a model: they are data to classify. Decontamination against the authors' training data (scan of 7 October 2026, 1,546,178 training records): 119 of 1000 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 57 more to restore the balance of the classes; 824 items remain. Decontamination against the training data of the final StartLux-Decision-27B (scan of 10 October 2026, 3,252,020 training records of Stage 1, Stage 2, Stage 3 and the RL pool): 18 of 824 items removed because a text field of the item occurs in it, and 10 more to restore the balance of the classes; 796 items remain.
